slide0.title: Pokémon Tower Defense
slide0.desc:
Place Pokémon to stop the incoming enemies!
Survive until Wave 50 before your lives run out.
slide0.d0: Lives: decrease by 1 each time an enemy breaks through
slide0.d1: Gold: earned by defeating enemies and clearing waves

slide1.title: Buy & Place Pokémon
slide1.desc:
Use the button on the bottom-right to buy Pokémon,
then click any green-highlighted cell to place them freely. (not near the path/entrance/exit)
slide1.d0: Entry fee 20G + Pokémon cost deducted (up to 6); reposition & swap freely between waves
slide1.d1: 💎 Terastal tile: a Pokémon standing on it changes type, boosting STAB & defensive matchups
slide1.d2: 🏪 Friendly Shop / 🎀 Contest Hall: put a Pokémon on part-time work (no attack/EXP) to unlock the item shop or raise rare-Pokémon odds over waves

slide2.title: Type Matchups & Synergies
slide2.desc:
Exploit type weaknesses for bonus damage!
Group same-type or same-generation Pokémon for synergy buffs!
slide2.d0: Attacking a weakness deals up to 2× damage
slide2.d2: Evolve & Mega Evolve for even more power

slide3.title: Wave Rewards
slide3.desc: Choose a reward item after clearing each wave.
slide3.d0: Rare Candy: level up one Pokémon
slide3.d1: Ether: revive a fainted Pokémon at 50% HP
slide3.d2: Mega Stone/Max Soup: Mega Evolve or Gigantamax

slide0.title: Multiplayer Mode
slide0.desc:
Up to 8 players compete in tower defense simultaneously
in a PvP battle mode!
slide0.d0: Create a room or join an existing one
slide0.d2: Game starts when all players are ready

slide1.title: Phase Flow
slide1.desc: Shop  Wave  Battle repeats every round.
slide1.d0: Shop: buy, place freely, and upgrade Pokémon
slide1.d1: Wave: all players run tower defense simultaneously
slide1.d2: Battle: auto-battle your team vs a random opponent

slide2.title: Battle & Lives
slide2.desc:
Losing a battle costs lives equal to the opponent's surviving Pokémon.
Reach 0 lives and you're eliminated!
slide2.d0: Start with 50 lives  reduced each battle loss
slide2.d1: Last player with lives remaining wins
slide2.d2: Rating changes based on wins and losses

slide3.title: TFT Battle Arena
slide3.desc: During the battle phase, Pokémon move and fight on their own across a 6×6 board in real time!
slide3.d0: Your team goes in the 2 columns on your side (MY ZONE); the opponent holds the far 2 columns
slide3.d1: Reposition Pokémon during prep time before battle
slide3.d2: Type matchups and stats apply  synergies matter!

slide0.title: Johto, Where People Vanished
slide0.desc:
The Captain's Johto Drift — reclaim its 8 gyms (chapters)
one by one from rampaging wild Pokémon!
slide0.d0: A story campaign played chapter by chapter, in order
slide0.d1: Clear a chapter by surviving its set number of waves
slide0.d2: A rampaging 'wild' boss appears on certain waves

slide1.title: Captain Yun & Friends
slide1.desc:
Fight alongside Captain Yun and his Pokémon partners.
Each chapter has its own set of usable Pokémon (heroes).
slide1.d0: The shop only offers that chapter's hero Pokémon
slide1.d1: Story dialogue plays at the start and on clear
slide1.d2: Type synergies are disabled in Story Mode

slide2.title: Each Gym's Enemy Type
slide2.desc:
Each gym is overrun by a specific Pokémon type.
Prepare the right type matchups in advance!
slide2.d0: Build a team strong against the chapter's enemy type
slide2.d1: Hit a weakness for up to 2× damage
slide2.d2: The boss is that gym ace's rampaging form — very tanky

slide3.title: Progress & Basics
slide3.desc:
Clearing a chapter unlocks the next one.
Placement, evolution, and controls match Single Play.
slide3.d0: Clear the previous chapter to unlock the next
slide3.d1: Free placement except near path/entrance/exit; use Terastal & Friendly Shop tiles (same as Single)
slide3.d2: Strengthen heroes via level-ups, evolution, and moves

slide0.title: What is Mini Pocket?
slide0.desc:
A Pocket-TCG-style mini auto-battler!
Collect cards, build a 6-card deck, and climb the tower via auto-battle.
slide0.d0: Standalone content, fully separate from the main tower defense
slide0.d2: Battles run automatically — your deck IS your skill

slide1.title: Packs & Collection
slide1.desc:
You start with 6 cards and some coins! Jump into the tower right away, or open packs to collect more.
Duplicate cards merge to raise a card's star rank.
slide1.d0: Normal / Type / Premium packs — higher tiers boost rare odds
slide1.d2: Earn coins & shards in bulk from the main game, a trickle from the tower

slide2.title: Deck Building & Synergy
slide2.desc:
Place cards across 3 front + 3 back slots (6 total).
Gathering the same type triggers synergy buffs.
slide2.d0: Front row tanks up front; back row deals from behind
slide2.d2: Some types 'pierce' — striking the enemy back row directly

slide3.title: Trainer Tower
slide3.desc:
Auto-battle rival trainers with your deck!
Enemies grow stronger each floor, with boss floors ahead.
slide3.d0: Battles are seed-based and deterministic — same deck, same result
slide3.d1: Clearing a floor rewards coins & star shards
slide3.d2: Spend rewards on more packs to strengthen your deck

slide4.title: Earning Coins & Shards
slide4.desc:
Mini Pocket currency is separate from main-game gold — it is not an exchange. You earn it on top, based on how far you get.
The main game is where you earn; Mini Pocket is where you spend!
slide4.d0: Single / Story: 4 + (wave÷6) coins per wave, plus 350 coins & 50 shards for clearing wave 50
slide4.d1: Multiplayer: one lump sum by final placement — 1st gets 300 coins & 40 shards, last still gets 80 & 8
slide4.d2: Tower pays small (10 + floor×2); shards mostly come from achievements & Pokédex milestones

slide5.title: How Battles Are Calculated
slide5.desc:
Cards use their original base stats. Higher star rank raises both level and stats.
(★1 Lv.30, +8 per star → ★5 Lv.62; stats +12% per star)
slide5.d0: Attacks use the higher of ATK / SP.ATK, and are taken on the matching DEF / SP.DEF
slide5.d1: Move type is auto-picked from the card's own types for best matchup — immune deals 0, crits deal ×1.5
slide5.d2: Turn order is by Speed — the same card moves first at a higher star rank
